title: Practice 1: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Простите за ___ (опоздание, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Pardon my being late.
exercises.why: **опоздание → опоздание** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он подпадает под ___ (описание, acc. sg.) в газете.
exercises.prompt: He answers to the description in the newspaper.
exercises.why: **описание → описание** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты платишь за ___ (качество, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: You pay for quality.
exercises.why: **качество → качество** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Давай взглянем под ___ (капот, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Let's take a look under the hood.
exercises.why: **капот → капот** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Благодарим Вас за ___ (заполнение, acc. sg.) этой формы.
exercises.prompt: Thank you for completing this form.
exercises.why: **заполнение → заполнение** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Загляни под ___ (кожа, acc. sg.) цивилизованному человеку и ты обнаружишь варвара.
exercises.prompt: Look under the skin of a civilized man and you will find a barbarian.
exercises.why: **кожа → кожу** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Спасибо за ___ (гостеприимство, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Thanks for the hospitality.
exercises.why: **гостеприимство → гостеприимство** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Это не подходит ни под ___ (одна категория, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: This doesn't fit into any category.
exercises.why: **категория → категорию** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like армия (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  **один → одну** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with категорию). «один» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (f. sg.): одна · одной · одной · одну · одной · одной.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том проклял себя за ___ (беспечность, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom cursed himself for his carelessness.
exercises.why: **беспечность → беспечность** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like часть (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Взрывное устройство было замаскировано под ___ (кассетный магнитофон, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The explosive device was disguised as a tape recorder.
exercises.why: **магнитофон → магнитофон** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **кассетный → кассетный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with магнитофон). Declines like новый (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Дёрни за ___ (шнур, acc. sg.) и спустишь воду.
exercises.prompt: Pull the string and the water flushes.
exercises.why: **шнур → шнур** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Его положили под ___ (наркоз, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He was put under anesthesia.
exercises.why: **наркоз → наркоз** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он взял за ___ (правило, acc. sg.), читая газету, ознакомляться с финансовым разделом.
exercises.prompt: He makes it a rule to go over the financial section every time he reads the paper.
exercises.why: **правило → правило** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мэри подпала под ___ (влияние, acc. sg.) Тома.
exercises.prompt: Mary succumbed to Tom's influence.
exercises.why: **влияние → влияние** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Давай возьмёмся за ___ (рука, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: Let's hold hands.
exercises.why: **рука → руки** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate. Declines like газета (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -и.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Просто замети это под ___ (коврик, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Just sweep it under the rug.
exercises.why: **коврик → коврик** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мэри схватила Тома за ___ (шиворот, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Mary grabbed Tom by the scruff of his neck.
exercises.why: **шиворот → шиворот** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Кто-то подкопался под ___ (наш забор, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Something burrowed under our fence.
exercises.why: **забор → забор** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **наш → наш** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with забор). Declines like наш. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он ухватился за ___ (верёвка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He caught hold of the rope.
exercises.why: **верёвка → верёвку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Силы Франко взяли под ___ (свой контроль, acc. sg.) Испанию.
exercises.prompt: Franco's forces took control in Spain.
exercises.why: **контроль → контроль** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like автомобиль (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with контроль). Declines like мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
